//: This repository's own configuration. It is also the worked example the documentation refers to: an artifact whose delivery boundary is not a deployment.

verification.//stage1: Everything that can be proven without leaving the working tree.
verification.//stage2: The boundary here is the plugin loader and the installer, not a server. Nothing in stage 1 can see either: static checks of the manifests validate one reading of the documentation, while the loader has its own.
stage2: claude plugin list          # must read: Status ✔ enabled
claude plugin details cerberus   # must list Skills (3)
# and the installer path, which is a second, independent boundary:
# then check that no file the project owns was written or merged into
verification.notes: Use an isolated CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR: installing into the real one changes the operator's own session. Verify against the pushed commit, not the working tree - the marketplace installs from GitHub, so an unpushed fix proves nothing. `claude plugin marketplace update` before reinstalling, or the cached copy is what gets tested.
